AI Video Generator: Flow AI

Meet Flow AI; the fun, fast, and mind-blowing way to turn any idea into a video. No editing skills, no complicated tools. Just type your thought, tap generate, and watch your video come to life.

Flow AI is built for creators who move fast. Whether you're making TikTok edits, YouTube Shorts, ASMR clips, or just having fun experimenting, Flow AI makes it insanely easy to create videos that pop.

It's powered by next-gen generative video models, including OpenAI's Sora 2, all boosted by our own engine for extra creativity and speed.

What makes Flow AI different?

Film Studio: full short films, not just clips. Pick a genre; action, sci-fi, horror, romance, comedy, cartoon, or let Flow AI interview you about your idea. It writes the scenario, casts the characters, and renders a 15, 30, 45 or 60 second film scene by scene.
100+ one-tap tools. Bring a photo to life, apply a viral effect, transform, morph, dance, age. Pick a tool, add a photo or a prompt, and get your clip back in about a minute.
Text to video. Describe the shot you want and get it, no reference image needed.
Vertical 9:16 output, ready for TikTok, Shorts and Reels.
Characters that stay consistent from shot to shot across a whole film.
Save straight to Photos or share to any app.

Designed for creators, not editors

Flow AI isn't just another video app. It's your personal creative sidekick; ready to turn anything you imagine into something people can't stop watching. Type a few words, hit generate, and your idea becomes a ready-to-share video that feels fresh, dynamic, and totally you.

Want cinematic? Done. Funny meme? Easy. Chill ASMR vibe? You got it. Flow AI adapts to your style and generates clips that match your energy.

The app blends generative AI with creator-driven tools to produce stunning results that look pro without any of the effort. It's all about letting your imagination run wild and creating content that stands out from the crowd.

Why creators love it

Flow AI makes content creation effortless. Instead of wasting hours on complex timelines or filters, you can focus on what actually matters; the idea. The rest is handled by AI so you can stay in flow.

Perfect for short-form content, creators use Flow AI for:

- Quick viral Shorts and Reels
- Chill ASMR edits
- Storytime or skit videos
- Promo or product clips
- Just-for-fun creative experiments

Your creativity deserves speed, style, and a bit of AI magic. Flow AI delivers all three.

Type it. Tap it. Flow it.
That's the power of Flow AI; ready to make your videos shine.

Subscription Information

Flow AI is free to download. Generating videos uses credits. A subscription unlocks all premium AI video tools and Film Studio, and adds credits with every renewal.

Subscription Plans:
Flow AI Pro; $9.99 per week, renews weekly
Flow AI Pro Max; $12.99 per week, renews weekly, with more credits per week

Your payment will be charged to your Apple ID once you confirm your purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically at the same price and period unless canceled at least 24 hours before the current period ends. Manage or cancel anytime in Settings, your Apple ID, Subscriptions. No refunds for unused time after cancellation.

Credit packs are also available as one-time purchases. Credits have no cash value, cannot be transferred or exchanged for cash, and are not refundable.

Disclaimer

All videos created by AI Video Generator: Flow AI are for entertainment purposes only. Users are responsible for how generated content is used. The app does not support impersonation or misuse of any likeness. By using Flow AI, you agree to follow all applicable copyright and content laws.

Are you ready to bring your photos to life with unique videos that surprise and delight? Introducing AI Video Maker – your one-stop app for creating magical videos from photos with a twist of AI! With just a few clicks, you can turn your static images into vibrant dance videos or heartwarming handshake animations. 
Whether it’s making your photos dance to the rhythm or bringing loved ones closer with a handshake, AI Video Maker provides endless fun and creativity.

Key Features:
1. Dynamic Dance Videos  
 
Bring your photos to life by turning them into exciting dance videos! AI Hug Video Maker uses advanced AI animation to detect and enhance facial features, creating natural-looking dance moves that synchronize with a variety of music genres. Upload your photos, select a dance theme, and watch as your pictures come alive with rhythm and motion. From hip-hop and salsa to classic moves, there’s a dance style for everyone.


2. Interactive Handshake Animations     
Want to share a special moment? Our Handshake Maker feature allows you to create realistic handshakes between two photos, making it appear as if two people in your pictures are shaking hands in real life. Perfect for friends, family members, and even colleagues, this feature uses advanced motion mapping to craft a unique video that feels heartfelt and personal.

3. User-Friendly and Fast     Designed for all skill levels, AI Hug Video Maker is intuitive and easy to navigate. The app features simple steps – just upload a photo, choose your animation style, and let AI do the work. In seconds, you’ll have a lively video that you can save, share, and enjoy!

4. Customization Options     Add a personal touch by selecting from various backgrounds, effects, and music tracks to accompany your animations. Personalize the look and feel of your video to make it more meaningful and suited to any occasion.

5. Social Sharing and Engagement     With one-tap sharing options, AI Hug Video Maker makes it easy to share your creations with friends and family. Post directly to social media or send your videos as messages to surprise someone special.

6. High-Quality Output     Enjoy HD quality videos that maintain the clarity and resolution of your original photos. Every detail of your images is preserved, ensuring your videos look great on any screen.


Why Choose AI Video Maker?  
AI Video Maker is more than just a photo animation app; it’s a platform to transform memories and add a personal, animated touch to your favorite photos. With our state-of-the-art AI technology, even the simplest photo can become a lively, animated story. Get creative, make memories, and share your animated moments with AI Video Maker today – where every photo has the potential to come to life!

Note: User can subscribe for 3 day free trial and make hug video unlimited times , after 3 day free trial he will be charged about $4.99 per week , which renews automatically , user can cancel his subscription before 24 hours anytime
